raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified Lord Patrick Crichton-Stuart’s father as John Stuart, 1st Marquess of Bute (d. 16 Nov 1814) instead of his actual father, John Stuart, Viscount Mount Stuart (the Marquess’s son), who died on 22 January 1794. This misreading of the Wikipedia snippet (“second son of John Stuart, Lord Mount Stuart, eldest son of the first Marquess”) led all subsequent searches to focus on the wrong person and thus the wrong death date.
